Applications And Practices Of Social Research
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sampling in which groups (not individuals) are randomly selected."
Cluster Sampling is a sampling in which groups (not individuals) are randomly selected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used because it enables researchers to compare their findings with chance expectations through statistical tests."
A Null Hypothesis is used because it enables researchers to compare their findings with chance expectations through statistical tests.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a somewhat informal technique that can help you assess user needs and feelings both before interface design and long after implementation."
Focus groups are a somewhat informal technique that can help you assess user needs and feelings both before interface design and long after implementation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic method of data collection."
Observation is a systematic method of data collection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an observation instrument used in the observation of activities of people within a given environment."
Close Circuit Television (CCTV) is an observation instrument used in the observation of activities of people within a given environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sampling technique which is recommended on some occasions when very quick results are needed."
Quota sampling is a sampling technique which is recommended on some occasions when very quick results are needed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to determine the probability that the null hypothesis is true."
Statistical tests are used to determine the probability that the null hypothesis is true.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the group of interest to the researcher, the group to which she or he would like the results of the study to be generalized on."
The population is the group of interest to the researcher, the group to which she or he would like the results of the study to be generalized on.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prepared list of questions but it is administered by giving the list to the respondent and asking them to fill it out in written form themselves."
A Questionnaire is a prepared list of questions but it is administered by giving the list to the respondent and asking them to fill it out in written form themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that there must be enough categories that all the observations will fall into some category."
Exhaustive means that there must be enough categories that all the observations will fall into some category.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of observing and recording the observations that are collected as part of a research effort."
Measurement is the process of observing and recording the observations that are collected as part of a research effort.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of numerical values assigned to subjects, object or behaviors for the purpose of quantifying and measuring qualities."
A Scale is a set of numerical values assigned to subjects, object or behaviors for the purpose of quantifying and measuring qualities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a comprehensive list of the elements or members of the population under investigation."
Sampling Frame is a comprehensive list of the elements or members of the population under investigation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of selecting a sample in such a way that all individuals in the defined population have an equal and independent chance of being selected for sample."
Random Sampling is the process of selecting a sample in such a way that all individuals in the defined population have an equal and independent chance of being selected for sample.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a qualitative research technique that allows a person to person discussion."
An in-depth interview is a qualitative research technique that allows a person to person discussion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the real variation from the true score, and includes both random error and systematic error."
Measurement error is the real variation from the true score, and includes both random error and systematic error.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a procedure whereby the researcher selects the required sample size at regular interval after the first element has been randomly selected."
The Systematic Sampling Technique is a procedure whereby the researcher selects the required sample size at regular interval after the first element has been randomly selected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a description and interpretation of a cultural or social group or system (Creswell, 1998)."
Ethnography is a description and interpretation of a cultural or social group or system (Creswell, 1998).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to facts or ideas or knowledge that is useful in answering a research problem."
Data refers to facts or ideas or knowledge that is useful in answering a research problem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variation of the Simple Random Sampling technique."
The Stratified Random Sampling technique is a variation of the Simple Random Sampling technique.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations or a tentative insight; possibly a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena."

Hypothesis refers to a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations or a tentative insight; possibly a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the hardest parts of your study."
Getting this clearly and thought-through is one of the hardest parts of your study.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of reasoning used in most intellectual activity but is studied primarily in the disciplines of computer science, mathematics and philosophy."
Logic is the study of reasoning used in most intellectual activity but is studied primarily in the disciplines of computer science, mathematics and philosophy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the relationship among the values that are assigned to the attributes for a variable."
The Level of Measurement refers to the relationship among the values that are assigned to the attributes for a variable.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of statements, including laws and hypotheses that explain a group of observations or phenomena in terms of those laws and hypotheses."
A theory is a set of statements, including laws and hypotheses that explain a group of observations or phenomena in terms of those laws and hypotheses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the consistency and dependency of a measure."
Reliability is the consistency and dependency of a measure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the important steps in the research process."
Sampling is one of the important steps in the research process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of related items or concepts that broadly explains your research."
A conceptual framework is a set of related items or concepts that broadly explains your research.
fib: ______ is the difference between the result obtained from a sample (a statistic) and the result which would have been obtained from the population (the corresponding parameter).
Sampling error
Sampling error is the difference between the result obtained from a sample (a statistic) and the result which would have been obtained from the population (the corresponding parameter).
______ is an alternative method of collection of data for research.
Interview
Interview is an alternative method of collection of data for research.
______ are one of the most widely used methods of gathering data in social sciences.
Interviews
Interviews are one of the most widely used methods of gathering data in social sciences.
______ is an essential characteristic of measurement in Social Research.
Validity
Validity is an essential characteristic of measurement in Social Research.
______ is the degree to which information or data matches true or accepted values.
Accuracy
Accuracy is the degree to which information or data matches true or accepted values.
______ is a postulated attribute or structure that explains a phenomenon such as an individual behavior.
construct
A construct is a postulated attribute or structure that explains a phenomenon such as an individual behavior.
______ is concerned with repeating a piece of research in order to establish the reliability of its findings.
Reliability or Internal Validity
Reliability or Internal Validity is concerned with repeating a piece of research in order to establish the reliability of its findings.
______ is the systematic scientific investigation of quantitative properties and phenomena and their relationships usually to develop and employ theories and/or hypotheses pertaining to a phenomenon.
Quantitative Research

Quantitative Research is the systematic scientific investigation of quantitative properties and phenomena and their relationships usually to develop and employ theories and/or hypotheses pertaining to a phenomenon.
______ means that the categories must be distinct enough that no observations will fall into more than one category.
Mutually exclusive
Mutually exclusive means that the categories must be distinct enough that no observations will fall into more than one category.
______ are used to measure attitudes, values and other characteristics.
Scales
Scales are used to measure attitudes, values and other characteristics.
______ is a list of program with several possible responses to each.
attitude scale
An attitude scale is a list of program with several possible responses to each.
______ is a source of measurement error.
Lack of equivalence
Lack of equivalence is a source of measurement error.
______ are used to present quantitative descriptions in a manageable form.
Descriptive Statistics
Descriptive Statistics are used to present quantitative descriptions in a manageable form.
______ is the process of establishing the representativeness of the items with respect to the domain of skills, tasks, knowledge and so forth of whatever is being measured.
Content Validity
Content Validity is the process of establishing the representativeness of the items with respect to the domain of skills, tasks, knowledge and so forth of whatever is being measured.
______ is the electoral register or population census.
closet
The closet is the electoral register or population census.
______ is a logical arrangement of the procedures and tools to be employed in a proposed research in order to minimize misinterpretation of the social phenomenon being investigated.
Research Design
Research Design is a logical arrangement of the procedures and tools to be employed in a proposed research in order to minimize misinterpretation of the social phenomenon being investigated.
______ refers to the level of measurement and exactness of description of the data set.
Precision
Precision refers to the level of measurement and exactness of description of the data set.
______ is a statistical procedure that uses sample data to evaluate the credibility of a hypothesis about a population.
hypothesis test
A hypothesis test is a statistical procedure that uses sample data to evaluate the credibility of a hypothesis about a population.
______ are used for studying the organization of social groups.
Sociometric techniques
Sociometric techniques are used for studying the organization of social groups.
______ is concerned with whether the test item represents measurement in the intended content area while Sampling Validity is concerned with how well the test sample the total content area.
Item Validity
Item Validity is concerned with whether the test item represents measurement in the intended content area while Sampling Validity is concerned with how well the test sample the total content area.
______ is the study of an individual and his/her experiences as told to the researcher or found in documents and archival records (Creswell, 1998).
biographical study
A biographical study is the study of an individual and his/her experiences as told to the researcher or found in documents and archival records (Creswell, 1998).
______ is a tool that is used to help researchers visualize the inter-relationships between concepts.
concept map
The concept map is a tool that is used to help researchers visualize the inter-relationships between concepts.
______ is used as a plausible general principle or body of principles offered to explain a phenomenon.
scientific theory
A scientific theory is used as a plausible general principle or body of principles offered to explain a phenomenon.
______ is the principle of anonymity which essentially means that the participant will remain anonymous throughout the study even to the researchers themselves.
stricter standard
The stricter standard is the principle of anonymity which essentially means that the participant will remain anonymous throughout the study even to the researchers themselves.
______ is the most complex in qualitative research and many of the data collection strategies involved in a qualitative project may feel familiar and comfortable.
Data analysis
Data analysis is the most complex in qualitative research and many of the data collection strategies involved in a qualitative project may feel familiar and comfortable.
______ is a standardized way of acknowledging the sources of information and ideas that you have used in your document.
Referencing
Referencing is a standardized way of acknowledging the sources of information and ideas that you have used in your document.
______ is the most commonly used method of data gathering in researches.
Face interview
Face to Face interview is the most commonly used method of data gathering in researches.
